Only pour introduces permettre here, and de requires participer rather than the finite forms. Both selections are visible from first attempt.
Si/car/dont cannot introduce the proposed purpose with any of the four subjectless verb forms. Pour circuler uniquely responds to the aisle constraint.
Pour indiquer is the unique combination for posting the times. The alternative conjunction chips require different syntax.
Pour devancer is the unique meaningful way to give the planned departure’s purpose from the listed options.
Only pour que can introduce ton détour soit court among the chips; the form cue no longer names the connector.
Pour que le son reste is the one complete clause compatible with lowering the volume in the courtyard.
Pour que sa tâche soit courte conveys Lina’s time limit; the other connector chips take a noun phrase instead.
Pour que la répétition en ligne marche supplies the purpose of the sound test. The three other connectors cannot introduce this clause.
Pour que le texte soit cohérent gives the reason for joint proofreading. The alternatives do not license that subjunctive clause.
The original hall’s steps still lead to the library alternative. Pour garder is the unique chip combination for keeping the access step-free.
